fixture_rule: Base fixture: one main and one oracle owned_supervisor_v19 history, both closed and mutually consistent; each case changes only the named element of the MAIN history unless stated, re-pinning digests/ACK fields needed to isolate it. S = synthetic predicate fixture (no OS provenance claim); N = native case needing its own parent GO. Expected causes are exact ordered sets in U_CAUSES/E_CAUSES order; no broadening. V4 base: every history has a valid baseline witness (observation_attempts start with 1-3 ADMISSION identity scans, only the last gap-free; its window holds exactly one unflagged observation per recorded baseline uid; ACK receipt baseline refs inside it and mono_complete >= its end); every helper mono_spawn > baseline completion; launched main histories are ACKs with receipt mono_spawn > completion; refusal fixtures are NOT-LAUNCHED (main_wait null) unless stated; no coverage gap, identity-less spawn, pending raw, halted or overflowed history. Endedness base: request R rebuilds CLOSED, identities = its prt_identities, a fresh make_census log with exactly one successful served call. Synthetic census/endedness cases replace module _bind_libproc with a fake (proc_pidinfo, proc_listallpids) pair so the genuine journal, validation and evaluation code runs; E19-E22 edit the module-private registry state and are labelled in-process tampering. V5: call build_identity_union with a parent-owned fresh exact retain list. Every census fixture is made by make_census(D), log.bind(T) exactly True, then census once; T is a fresh module-instance-unique lowerhex64 token and D the identical original predicate. Every evaluator uses evaluate_endedness(R,reader,census,log,identities,D,T,retain=fresh_exact_list). All synthetic log edits must preserve the new release_token and empty error_chain on accepted attempt ends. Native failure examples follow the v6 _native selection rule: a non-Exception primary outranks an ordinary completion secondary; otherwise the secondary propagates; completion pass -> primary (H09, H11-H16). Unless a case says otherwise, retention is below the admission stop.
